scope: One bounded premise and layout decision for lighting round 6. The planner did not build or score.
plan:
**Blackout Lab as a light rehearsal.** A theatre producer switches cues on one original inline scene of a half-open stage curtain. Three broad folds and one turned hem give each light something to reveal. Aim for the quiet concentration of a technical rehearsal. Omit figures, thumbnails and decorative controls.

**Light and type.** Stage charcoal `#191C20`, curtain slate `#626B74`, paper white `#F5F3EB`, amber `#E8A348`, backlight blue `#508BFF`. Dusk washes the folds amber. Static catches one side of each fold in hard white and casts a sharp floor shadow. Flood silhouettes the cloth and lights the gap behind the hem blue. Use Barlow Condensed Semibold for the title and cue names, Barlow Regular for the technique.

**Layout.** At 1440 CSS px, center a 960 px column. Place the title above a 960 × 420 scene, then a centered 480 px control block 16 px below. At 390, use 16 px margins and a 358 × 300 scene. At both widths, place three equal tabs above the selected technique with an 8 px gap. Inset the focus ring and underline the selection. Switch light instantly, including with reduced motion.

**Live acceptance check.** At both widths, tab to Dusk and arrow through all cues. Reject the layout if any switch requires scrolling to see the lit hem, focused tab and matching technique together.
